The '''Twitgunner''' functioned mostly like a generic tower, firing from its pistol and later Uzi at enemies. Its stats and even store description were directly copied from the default [[Scout]] with some very minor changes. }} ==Strategy== *Due to its cheap cost and DPS, this tower would mostly end up being a better [[Scout]] for early-game. ==Trivia== *The '''Twitgunner''' was most likely a successor to the Clout God, the original version of the [[Hunter]]. **Many of its Levels, especially Level 4-5 bear huge resemblance to the Clout God. **Some of the tower textures, like the phone used while it would tweet were made in August of 2019, meaning they are most likely reused textued from the Clout God. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Twitgunner''' added. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **Firerate decreased as the severity of the [[Firerate Bug]] was reduced. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.53 to 1.525. ***'''Level 4''' ****Firerate decreased from {{Tooltip|1.53 > 0.78|-0.3}} to {{Tooltip|1.525 > 0.775|-0.3}}. *'''21 March 2023''' - [[v1.6.3]]e **'''Twitgunner''' removed. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Ground]]
